description: Official executive, standards, civil-rights, consumer-protection, and health-regulation sources for U.S. AI governance.

source_portals.name: White House Presidential Actions
source_portals.coverage_notes: Executive orders and presidential directives that shape federal AI policy.

source_portals.name: White House Releases
source_portals.coverage_notes: Fact sheets, policy announcements, and implementation updates tied to AI governance.

source_portals.name: NIST Artificial Intelligence
source_portals.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source_portals.coverage_notes: Federal technical standards, frameworks, and implementation resources for trustworthy AI.

source_portals.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
source_portals.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source_portals.coverage_notes: Framework pages, profiles, and playbooks for AI risk management.

source_portals.name: OSTP AI Bill of Rights
source_portals.issuing_body: White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official White House OSTP materials on rights-protective AI governance, including the Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights and companion implementation guidance.

source_portals.name: FTC AI Policy and Reports
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official FTC reports and policy materials addressing consumer protection, bias, surveillance, and deceptive or unfair AI practices.

source_portals.name: Interagency AI Enforcement Statement
source_portals.issuing_body: Department of Justice / EEOC / FTC / CFPB
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official interagency civil-rights, consumer-protection, and equal-opportunity materials on unlawful discrimination and bias in automated systems.

source_portals.name: FDA AI-Enabled Medical Device Guidance
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official FDA guidance and supporting materials for AI-enabled medical devices, including premarket, lifecycle, and change-control expectations.

source_portals.name: CFPB AI and Algorithmic Finance
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official CFPB circulars and research reports on algorithmic credit decisions, chatbot deployment, and AI-related consumer-finance harms.

source_portals.name: Federal Register — Presidential Documents & AI/SI Rulemaking
source_portals.coverage_notes: Authoritative federal gazette for Executive Orders (EO 14409, EO 14434, Dec 2025 National Policy Framework EO) and federal AI/Super Intelligence rulemaking.

source_portals.name: NIST Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) / Super Intelligence Portal
source_portals.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST / CAISI)
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official portal for NIST CAISI frontier evaluations, the 2026 AI/SI Agent Standards Initiative, NCCoE agent-IAM concept papers, and CSRC Cyber AI Profile (NIST IR 8596).

source_portals.name: GovInfo Public Laws (U.S. Congress)
source_portals.issuing_body: U.S. Government Publishing Office / U.S. Congress
source_portals.coverage_notes: Canonical federal statutory repository for enacted U.S. AI legislation (e.g., TAKE IT DOWN Act, Pub. L. 119-12).

source_portals.name: HHS Assistant Secretary for Technology Policy / ONC Health IT
source_portals.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS / ONC)
source_portals.coverage_notes: Federal health IT certification rules governing clinical AI and predictive decision support interventions (HTI-1).

source_portals.name: U.S. Department of the Treasury — AI & Cybersecurity in Finance
source_portals.coverage_notes: Treasury reports and risk-management guidance on AI cybersecurity, fraud, and financial-sector governance.

source_portals.name: Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) — Advanced Computing Export Controls
source_portals.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security
source_portals.coverage_notes: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) rules governing advanced AI semiconductors, remote compute access, and model controls.

source_portals.name: U.S. Copyright Office — Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official U.S. Copyright Office policy reports on AI copyrightability, generative AI training, and fair use.

source_portals.name: U.S. Department of Defense — Directives & AI Autonomy Policy
source_portals.coverage_notes: DoD issuances governing autonomy in weapon systems, human judgment controls, and defense AI governance.

source_portals.name: U.S. State Legislative Registries (Opt-In Subnational AI Overlay)
source_portals.issuing_body: U.S. State Legislatures (CA, CO, TX, NY)
source_portals.coverage_notes: Authoritative state legislative portals tracked strictly under corpus_role='subnational_overlay' (excluded from federal sovereign baselines by default).

seed_documents.title: Combatting Online Harms Through Innovation: A Report to Congress

seed_documents.relevance_notes: Official CFPB circular clarifying that lenders using complex algorithms in credit decisions must still provide specific reasons in adverse action notices under ECOA and Regulation B.

seed_documents.title: Chatbots in consumer finance
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Official CFPB issue spotlight identifying legal and consumer-protection risks from chatbot deployment in financial services, especially when firms substitute away from live human support.

seed_documents.title: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security (91 FR 34565)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Signed June 2, 2026 (published 91 FR 34565, June 5, 2026). Establishes federal AI cybersecurity clearinghouse and voluntary 30-day pre-release federal evaluation access for frontier developers while rejecting mandatory federal licensing.

seed_documents.title: Executive Order 14434: Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence (91 FR 63129)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Signed September 29, 2026 (published 91 FR 63129, October 2, 2026). Directs executive agencies to adopt 'Super Intelligence (SI)' nomenclature across official non-statutory documents and portals; major federal strategic framing pivot.

seed_documents.title: Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence (90 FR 58499)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Signed December 11, 2025 (published 90 FR 58499, December 16, 2025). Establishes DOJ task force addressing state AI regulatory fragmentation and ties broadband/federal funding to uniform national framework principles.

seed_documents.title: TAKE IT DOWN Act (Public Law 119-12, 139 Stat. 55)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: First binding U.S. federal AI deepfake / nonconsensual intimate imagery criminal and platform notice-and-takedown statute (139 Stat. 55); FTC 48-hour takedown enforcement entered into force May 19, 2026.

seed_documents.title: NIST CAISI / SI Agent Standards Initiative
seed_documents.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST / CAISI)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 2026 NIST Center for AI / SI Standards and Innovation initiative establishing technical standards for autonomous AI agent identity, authentication, interoperability, and security.

seed_documents.title: NIST IR 8596 (Initial Preliminary Draft): Cybersecurity Framework Profile for Artificial Intelligence (Cyber AI Profile)
seed_documents.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 107-page NIST IR 8596 Initial Preliminary Draft community profile mapping NIST CSF 2.0 controls to securing AI systems, conducting AI-enabled cyber defense, and thwarting AI-enabled cyber threats. Quarantined as draft_consultation until final publication.

seed_documents.title: HHS / ONC HTI-1 Final Rule: Health Data, Technology, and Interoperability — Certification Program Updates, Algorithm Transparency, and Information Sharing (89 FR 1192)
seed_documents.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS / ONC)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Binding federal regulation (45 CFR Part 170, 89 FR 1192) establishing 'FAVES' intervention risk management, source-attribute transparency, and ongoing maintenance-of-certification duties for Predictive Decision Support Interventions (AI/ML) in certified health IT.

seed_documents.title: Managing Artificial Intelligence-Specific Cybersecurity Risks in the Financial Services Sector
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 52-page Treasury OCCIP report detailing AI-specific cybersecurity, fraud, data poisoning, third-party supply-chain, and model risk management controls for U.S. financial institutions.

seed_documents.title: BIS Rule: Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors (91 FR 74970)
seed_documents.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Binding November 19, 2026 BIS Export Administration Regulations rule (91 FR 74970) establishing federal compute governance, know-your-customer, licensing, and access controls over remote cloud access to advanced AI semiconductors.

seed_documents.title: BIS Final Rule: Revision to License Review Policy for Advanced Computing Commodities (91 FR 1684)
seed_documents.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Binding January 15, 2026 BIS final rule (91 FR 1684) revising EAR export license review standards, technical testing, and security conditions for advanced AI computing chips.

seed_documents.title: Copyright and Artificial Intelligence, Part 3: Generative AI Training
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 113-page U.S. Copyright Office report analyzing copyright law, fair use factors, lawful access, opt-out mechanisms, and voluntary licensing for generative AI training datasets.

seed_documents.title: Copyright and Artificial Intelligence, Part 2: Copyrightability
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 52-page U.S. Copyright Office report setting federal standards on human authorship, AI-assisted creative control, and copyrightability of AI-generated outputs.

seed_documents.title: DoD Directive 3000.09: Autonomy in Weapon Systems
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Binding DoD issuance establishing senior-level review, rigorous hardware/software V&V and T&E, cybersecurity safeguards, and appropriate levels of human judgment over autonomous and semi-autonomous weapon systems.

seed_documents.title: California SB 53: Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act (TFAIA)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Enacted California frontier AI safety statute imposing 10^26 FLOPs compute thresholds, published frontier AI safety frameworks, catastrophic-risk assessments, critical safety incident reporting to CalOES, and whistleblower protections. Tracked under opt-in subnational_overlay.

seed_documents.title: California AB 2013: Generative Artificial Intelligence — Training Data Transparency Act
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Enacted California statute mandating public high-level summaries of generative AI training datasets including sources, IP status, personal data, and synthetic data disclosures. Tracked under opt-in subnational_overlay.

seed_documents.title: Colorado SB 24-205: Consumer Protections for Artificial Intelligence
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Pioneering 2024 Colorado high-risk AI algorithmic discrimination statute; repealed and reenacted by SB 26-189 (May 14, 2026). Tracked under opt-in subnational_overlay as superseded baseline for longitudinal state-law diff.

seed_documents.title: Colorado SB 26-189: Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT) Act (Ch. 131)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Enacted May 14, 2026 (Session Laws Ch. 131, effective Jan 1, 2027) repealing and replacing Colorado SB 24-205 with targeted consumer protections and disclosures for Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT) in consequential decisions. Tracked under opt-in subnational_overlay.

seed_documents.title: Texas HB 149: Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (TRAIGA)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Enacted 89th Texas Legislature statute prohibiting harmful/discriminatory AI uses, regulating government AI transparency and biometric scraping, creating an AI regulatory sandbox, and vesting exclusive enforcement in the Texas Attorney General. Tracked under opt-in subnational_overlay.

seed_documents.title: New York S6953A: Responsible AI Safety and Education (RAISE) Act
seed_documents.relevance_notes: New York frontier AI safety statute mandating written safety and security protocols, third-party audits, 72-hour critical safety incident reporting, and Attorney General civil enforcement for large frontier model developers. Tracked under opt-in subnational_overlay.
